import re,html,pathlib,collections
t=pathlib.Path('products/research/paid-review-contests/official-directory.html').read_text()
txt=re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>',' ',t,flags=re.S)
txt=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','\n',txt))
lines=[l.strip() for l in txt.split('\n') if l.strip()]
print('\n'.join(f'{i} {l[:140]}' for i,l in enumerate(lines[:60])))
slugs=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/audits/([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9-]+)',t)))
print(slugs[40:])
st=re.findall(r'\\"status\\":\\"([^\\]+)',t)
print(collections.Counter(st))
for k in ['Active','Upcoming','Ongoing','Open','Bot Race','active']:
  print(k,len(re.findall(k,t)))
for m in re.finditer(r'\\"status\\":\\"(Judging|Reporting|Active|Upcoming)',t):
  s=t[max(0,m.start()-600):m.start()+200]
  print('CTX',re.findall(r'(?:slug|title|startDate|endDate|start|end)\\":\\"([^\\]{1,80})',s))
